(I)--The architect of the Asuras of the other world, and a past master in the practice of माया। Served as calf for the मायिन्स् to derive माया from Earth. Built aerial cities, three in number, of gold, silver and iron for the pro- tection of the Asuras, and constructed the divine सभा। The cities were well equipped and furnished, with paintings and drawings of couples of नागस् and Asuras, pigeons, parrots and शारिकस्, interspersed by charming gardens of flowers and fruits with lakes of crystal waters. Being the Lord of Tripura which he built, he took part with Bali in the देवासुर war, and also fought with विश्वकर्- man;
1: भा. I. १५. 8;

. ३७; IV. १८. २०; V. २४. 9-१०; VII. १०. २२ and २९, ५१-60.
son of विश्वकर्मन्; सुरेणु was his sister;
2: Br. III. ५९. २१; IV. १२. 3; २०. ४६; ३१. 7; वा. ८४. २०-1.
had an evil dream that a naked lady and a man of three eye burning the city: reported it to the सभा: was explained by नारद: precautions for defence: army stationed at respec- tive places of vantage; विद्युन्मालि was over-powered; Maya constructed a tank of medicinal waters to make the dead live and restored विद्युन्मालि. Knowing this immortalising fluid, ब्रह्मा and Hari drank the whole of it; fierce war; शिव directed his arrows against the three cities and killed the Asuras by destroying their cities. Maya's address to the Asuras for a bold stand. विद्युन्मालि and तारक were killed. Maya was let off and asked to live in a special house [page२-635+ ३२] after burning the city. In the तारकामय it is said he rode on a golden chariot with arms and weapons.
3: M. ch. १२९; १३१. २५-30; १३४. 9-३०; chh. १३५-140. १७

--the form which विष्णु took to vanquish the Asuras under ह्राद who defeated the Gods; he ap- proached the Asuras as a naked mendicant, clean shaven and with a bunch of peacock feathers, performing austeri- [page२-690+ २९] ties in the नर्मदा and led them from the path of the Vedas by calling them Arhats; they left the trodden path and abandoned vedic practices and rites, and decried vedic sacrifices. Vi. III. १७. १४-45; १

--Rati in her former birth: when her hus- band was burnt by शिव, she was reborn as the superinten- dent of शम्बर's kitchen. Hearing from नारद that Pradyumna was काम and that he was thrown into sea by शम्बर and swallowed by a fish and was brought to her kitchen, she nursed him lovingly and when he came of age, she spoke the truth and taught him महामाया विद्या with which he killed शम्बर: She took him by air to कृष्ण and was rejoiced to become the daughter-in-law of कृष्ण and रुक्मिणी. भा. X. ५५. 6-३८; Vi. V. २७. 7-१६, २७-30.
--are the Daityas, दानवस् and काद्र- veyas; enjoy life to the utmost; only afraid of Hari's चक्र। भा. V. २४. 8. ११-15.
--a son of Maya and रम्भा. Br.
